scope_note: Covers the contract values at which the duties in the Procurement Reform (Scotland) Act 2014 apply, and the minimum values for goods, services and works to be a regulated procurement. Deliberately excludes the separate, higher thresholds of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015 and the Procurement Act 2023, except to distinguish them.

steps.title: Establish what a regulated procurement is
steps.detail: Retrieve the definitions of regulated procurement and regulated contract, and the conditions a contract must meet.

steps.title: Retrieve the threshold figures
steps.detail: Retrieve the contract threshold table and the figures for public contracts other than works, and for public works contracts.

steps.title: Check whether the figures have been amended
steps.detail: Establish whether any order under the power to amend the table has changed them.

steps.title: Separate the neighbouring regimes
steps.detail: Establish what a higher value regulated procurement is, so the 2014 Act thresholds are not confused with those of the 2015 Regulations or the Procurement Act 2023.
